newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July 1st 10 days trade surplus 115.4 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan July 1st 10 days trade surplus 115.4 bln yen.

text.p: Japan posted a customs-cleared trade surplus of 115.40 billion yen in the first 10 days of July, compared with a revised deficit of 26.12 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Thursday.
It compared with a trade surplus of 149.82 billion yen in the first 10 days of June.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 16.6 percent from a year earlier to 1.36 trillion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 4.3 percent to 1.24 trillion yen.
